metadata.description: Ticket-to-PR development workflow skills. Jira, Azure DevOps and GitHub Issues, or a backlog in the repo when there is no tracker at all.

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: Ten skills covering the path from a ticket to a pull request: triage-task, plan-change, implement-change, review-diff, write-commit, draft-pr, address-review, write-handover for the people who are not engineers, plus frame-product and trace-incident for work that starts from an idea or a symptom instead. Plans carry file:line citations that a script reopens and checks; implementation is held to the file list the plan declared. `wb next` resolves which ticket a session is on and prints the one command to run. The quality bar is detected with a stated confidence, can differ per path in a monorepo, and the audit fails a plan declared below it. Git stays read-only by default; an opt-in --execute runs only allowlisted commands, never a force-push. Works against Jira, Azure DevOps and GitHub Issues, or with no tracker at all.
